title: Horrible scam of an app
body:
The first shady trick they tried to do with users: 
1. They put a very loud music when app open for the first time.
2. In the same moment they ask to accept 50$ yearly subscription (in the first second of opening app…)
3. They hope users will mistake the side of iPhone low volume button and will double tap the side of the buy confirmation button. 

Fabulous team - you are the worst people!
